neon-shooter.title: Neon Defender
neon-shooter.subtitle: Space shooter · Waves & bosses
neon-shooter.description: Dodge bullets, collect upgrades, and face a boss every three waves.

faune-dungeon.title: Faune Dungeon
faune-dungeon.subtitle: Five chapters · Woodland adventure
faune-dungeon.description: Explore five distinct ruins, collect ancient seals, avoid traps, and face the Heart Warden.

wind-chime-memory.title: Wind Chime Memory
wind-chime-memory.subtitle: Ceramic courtyard · Musical memory
wind-chime-memory.description: Listen to the chimes, then tap the melody back. Three difficulties, autosave, and silent play.

postcard-slide.title: Postcards from the Hills
postcard-slide.subtitle: Watercolor journeys · Three sizes
postcard-slide.description: Slide the paper pieces to piece together a hillside city at sunset.

star-letters.title: Star Letters
star-letters.subtitle: 3D fairy-tale adventure · Touch supported
star-letters.description: Follow a letter, visit friends on three planets, and bring a late spring to a giant’s garden. Phone touch controls supported. About 54 MB on first load.

signal-harbor.title: Signal Harbor
signal-harbor.subtitle: A quiet night harbor · Three chapters
signal-harbor.description: Use a spare berth to guide the lights home. 24 puzzles, with free level selection.

unlock-bolts-mobile.title: Nuts & Bolts
unlock-bolts-mobile.subtitle: Color sorting · Five levels
unlock-bolts-mobile.description: Give it a little thought and put every color back where it belongs.

star-triad.title: Star Triad
star-triad.subtitle: Moonlit enamel · Solo / two players
star-triad.description: Align stars and moons in a moonlit observatory. Play solo or share the screen, with autosave and resume.

firefly-four.title: Firefly Four
firefly-four.subtitle: Firefly paper lanterns · Solo / two players
firefly-four.description: As dusk settles over the bamboo pavilion, be the first to light four lanterns in a row.

moss-reversi.title: Moss Reversi
moss-reversi.subtitle: A paper moss garden · Solo / two players
moss-reversi.description: Turn the tide with ink stones and white porcelain in a paper garden.

kiln-merge.title: Kiln Merge
kiln-merge.subtitle: Hand-painted pottery · Slide & merge
kiln-merge.description: Merge celadon tiles and slowly fire a 2048 of your own.

petal-memory.title: Petal Memory
petal-memory.subtitle: Botanical paper cards · Match pairs
petal-memory.description: Turn over hand-painted flower cards and test your memory against a botanist or a friend.

silk-serpent.title: Silk Serpent
silk-serpent.subtitle: Silk lantern garden · Three difficulties
silk-serpent.description: Guide a red silk dragon through a lantern-lit courtyard, gathering pearls as it grows.

bamboo-rally.title: Bamboo Rally
bamboo-rally.subtitle: Ink-wash bamboo court · Paddle rally
bamboo-rally.description: Drag your paddle through a sunlit bamboo courtyard. Practice solo or play with a friend.

rc-rally.title: RC Rally
rc-rally.subtitle: RC racing · Two-lap time trial
rc-rally.description: Drive your RC car through checkpoints and chase the fastest two-lap time.

civ-clicker.title: CivClicker
civ-clicker.subtitle: City building · People & production
civ-clicker.description: Start with a tent, assign your people to work, and build a city of your own.

crowd-runner.title: Crowd Rush
crowd-runner.subtitle: Number-gate runner · Eight levels
crowd-runner.description: Choose the right gates, grow your crowd, and rush to the finish.

arrow-escape.title: Arrow Escape
arrow-escape.subtitle: Arrow puzzles · 36 levels
arrow-escape.description: Find the right order and let every arrow escape the board.
